title: Team Telecom Mitigation Agreements
excerpt: Every executed Team Telecom mitigation agreement held in the corpus — Records double-tagged team-telecom and mitigation-agreement — one row per instrument, newest first, with superseding and companion instruments folded beneath their row.

entries.label: OneWeb Eutelsat LOA
entries.text:
Designate and maintain U.S. law enforcement points of contact subject to USG Parties’ approval.
Provide responsive information for Lawful U.S. Process within the United States and within the required time.
Prevent unauthorized access to U.S. Records, domestic communications, and domestic communications infrastructure.
Report known or suspected security incidents and material breaches to USG Parties within 72 hours.
Obtain review or non-objection before introducing or modifying Principal Equipment.

entries.label: 2022 5 23 Peerless TT 214 LOA
entries.text:
Maintain a U.S.-based law-enforcement point of contact subject to DOJ and FBI approval.
Keep U.S. Records responsive to lawful U.S. process within the United States and provide them promptly.
Do not disclose or provide access to U.S. Records, domestic communications, or related infrastructure to foreign governments, entities, or persons without DOJ or U.S. court approval.
Report security incidents and specified breaches to DOJ within 72 hours.
Submit and maintain cybersecurity and system security plans for DOJ review.

entries.label: Plant LOA
entries.text:
Designate and maintain a U.S. law-enforcement point of contact subject to DOJ and FBI approval.
Provide responsive U.S. Records promptly in response to lawful U.S. process, no later than five days unless DOJ grants an extension.
Do not disclose or provide access to U.S. Records, domestic communications, or domestic communications infrastructure to a foreign government without prior written DOJ consent or a U.S. court order.
Prepare and implement cybersecurity and system security plans guided by current NIST standards.
Report known or suspected security incidents, unauthorized access or disclosure, and material breaches to DOJ within 72 hours.

entries.label: All West Communications - Team Telecom mitigation agreement
entries.text:
Designate and maintain a U.S. law-enforcement point of contact approved by DOJ/FBI.
Designate and maintain a qualified U.S. citizen security officer.

Report security incidents or material breaches to DOJ within 48 hours.

entries.label: Spanish Broadcasting System LOA - Team Telecom
entries.text:
